description: This Java class defines a phone-side configuration activity for a digital watch face, allowing users to set background and digit colors, and communicates these settings to the watch via GoogleApiClient and Wearable DataApi.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceCompanionConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for configuring watch face settings remotely, handling GoogleApiClient connection, data retrieval, and user interactions to update watch face colors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and prepares GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles successful connection to GoogleApiClient, retrieves current watch face config.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Processes the result of data item retrieval, sets up UI pickers.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: displayNoConnectedDeviceDialog
methods.description: Shows alert if no device is connected.

methods.name: setUpAllPickers
methods.description: Configures UI pickers based on current config or defaults.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerSelection
methods.description: Sets the selected color in a spinner based on config or default.

methods.name: setUpColorPickerListener
methods.description: Attaches listener to spinner to send color updates.

methods.name: sendConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Sends color configuration updates to the watch.
